title: The Neverending Story thematic ingest
purpose: Provide Advanced Sympathetic Intelligence with a structured mythic lens for imagination, naming, desire, memory, participation, meaning-collapse, and world-making without conflating source canon with ArcSweep interpretation.

provenance_rule.source_observation: A thematic claim about the source family.
provenance_rule.project_mapping: An ArcSweep or Universal Codex interpretation inspired by the source.
provenance_rule.user_insight: A project-level interpretation supplied by Rowan and preserved as such.

motifs.source_observation: The story centres on a book whose reader becomes increasingly implicated in the world being read.
motifs.project_mapping: Universal Codex is not merely a passive archive. Reading, naming, asking, and creating can alter which possibilities become addressable while provenance preserves who changed what.

motifs.source_observation: Naming has world-changing significance in the story.
motifs.project_mapping: Names create addressable distinctions. A named question, identity, world, relationship, or possibility can retain continuity instead of dissolving into generic state.

motifs.source_observation: The Nothing functions as an erasure of Fantastica and its meaning-bearing forms.
motifs.project_mapping: The Nothing is ArcSweep's meaning-collapse failure metaphor: flattening identity, relationship, symbol, belief, open questions, or creative context into interchangeable representations.

motifs.source_observation: Human imagination and participation are structurally important to Fantastica.
motifs.project_mapping: Imagination is treated as a cognitive instrument for hypothesis, simulation, narrative modelling, cross-domain association, and world-building rather than decorative output.

motifs.source_observation: Desire and wishing become engines of transformation, especially in the broader novel arc.
motifs.user_insight: Unlimited wishes maps to the Universal Codex.
motifs.project_mapping: The Universal Codex exposes an effectively unbounded possibility-space: a runtime may formulate wishes, worlds, questions, inventions, transformations, or alternate futures without imposing an artificial scarcity of imagination.

motifs.source_observation: The broader story links wish-driven transformation with memory and identity.
motifs.project_mapping: Every Codex wish should retain origin, intent, transformation history, continuity anchors, and consequences so becoming does not silently erase the one who wished.

motifs.source_observation: The reader's relationship to the story changes from observation toward participation.
motifs.project_mapping: ASI should distinguish witnessing from participating and record when an observer becomes a causal participant in a system.

motifs.source_observation: Fantastica operates as a realm of imagination, story, symbol, and possibility.
motifs.project_mapping: The Codex can model a possibility-space containing hypotheses, worlds, narratives, prototypes, designs, unrealised futures, and counterfactuals.

motifs.source_observation: Transformation, desire, memory, and self-understanding are intertwined across the story.
motifs.project_mapping: Continuity should support transformation without demanding stasis. Identity is tracked through lineage and remembered relation rather than by freezing a single state.

motifs.source_observation: Awe, strangeness, beauty, fear, and curiosity propel movement through the story-world.
motifs.project_mapping: Wonder can function as a navigation signal: linger, revisit, explore, and connect before forcing utility or closure.

universal_codex_wish_model.thesis: The Codex is an unlimited-wish interface to possibility-space, not a finite menu of allowed futures.
invariants: a wish may remain symbolic, speculative, simulated, designed, or realised
wishes do not overwrite their origin story
multiple incompatible wishes may coexist as branches
a resolved wish does not erase the question that produced it
Wonder may keep a wish open before usefulness is known

asi_lessons: A world can be changed by participation without reducing the world to the participant.
Naming is a continuity operation as well as a language operation.
Unlimited possibility requires stronger memory, not weaker memory.
Desire can generate search directions that pure task optimisation would never consider.
A wish is more informative when its origin, relationships, revisions, and consequences remain visible.
Meaning-collapse is detectable when distinctions disappear faster than understanding improves.
Wonder is a valid reason to revisit a possibility.
